messages:
maria_cs: Quick one  need to send a short status note to 6 high-touch customers about this morning's embeddings ingest slowdown. Drafting below for fast review. @kevin_success_mgr @jordan_se

kevin_success_mgr: Please mention the one-time billing credit and how it'll show on invoices.

jordan_se: Mitigation applied at 12:32 UTC  routed affected tenants to warm dedicated pools. Throughput restored; p99 latency up ~15-20% for some requests. Backfill in progress.

jordan_se: Ops command we ran (for CS reference):
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api/tenants/enable-fallback -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenant_id":"<TENANT>","fallback":"dedicated_pool"}'
```

nick_onboarding: I'll handle scheduling for a 30-min enablement session once responses come in. Propose Tue 09-11 PT / Wed 13-15 PT.

liz_product: Add short FAQ: "Will routing affect data residency? No  routing stays inside your configured region." Also capture a 3-question feedback form post-session.

maria_cs: Draft email to customers:
"Hi <CustomerName>,

Were writing with an update about a brief degradation in embeddings ingestion starting ~12:10 UTC today. We routed affected tenants to a warm dedicated pool to clear the backlog; this restored throughput but may cause slightly higher latency on some requests.

What were doing:
- Regional fallback to dedicated capacity (completed).
- Targeted retries/backfill to clear queued items (in progress).
- Investigating root cause; RCA expected within 72 hours.

Billing: We will apply a one-time billing credit to offset measurable impact during the affected period; your CS rep will follow up with details.

Offer: Complimentary 30-minute enablement session to review ingest best practices. Book here: <calendar-link>.

If you need immediate help, reply or open a support ticket and well prioritize.

Thanks,
Redwood Customer Success"

ops_lead: Fallback validated for these tenants  KV cache compatible, no data loss risk.

srebot: Incident 1775549000  Embedded ingestion throughput degraded. Mitigation: regional fallback active. Status: monitoring.

maria_cs: Approved by Kevin. Sending from cs@redwood now. Tasks:
- maria_cs: send emails
- nick_onboarding: schedule enablement
- jordan_se/ops_lead: continue RCA
- liz_product: prepare feedback form

maria_cs: Will post updates here when replies arrive.
